title: Residential Natural Gas Supply Billing Service Standard — Carried-Charge Supplement
content:
**Standard.** When a latest-bill rebill credit is owed on a Residential Natural Gas Supply agreement, the carried-charge supplement depends on the calendar days from the disputed line's posting date to the day the credit is posted: 10.00 when they are 21 or more, 5.00 when they are at least 7 but fewer than 21, and no supplement when they are fewer than 7. The supplement, in US dollars, is added to the latest-bill rebill credit.

The record read is the posting date of the disputed energy line on the agreement's bill ledger; the other end of the span is the day the rebill credit is posted.

| Calendar days from the line's posting date to the credit's posting date | Carried-charge supplement (USD) |
|---|---|
| 21 or more | 10.00 |
| 7 to 20 | 5.00 |
| 0 to 6 | none |

### Cases (hypothetical; line posted 3 March)

| Credit posted on | Days | Supplement |
|---|---|---|
| 24 March | 21 | 10.00 |
| 23 March | 20 | 5.00 |
| 10 March | 7 | 5.00 |
| 9 March | 6 | none |
